title: ota-build build.json
description: <build dir>/build.json written by `ota-build bundle` (packages/ota-build/src/bundle.ts, interface BuildJson). Lists the Hermes bytecode files of a platform build with their hashes and the toolchain that made them. Consumed by `ota-build patch`, `base-info` and verifyBuildDir (which re-hashes every referenced file). Hashes here are "sha256:" + 64 hex. The optional `delta` block records whether the .hbc files were compiled with `hermesc -base-bytecode` (patch builds) and the sha256 of every JS input. NOT expressible: delta.enabled iff delta.baseBuild is non-null; delta.files lists exactly host + units; baseHbc present on every file when enabled; referenced files exist and match their hash; host/unit toolchain versions agree.

appVersion.description: Binary release line (--app-version); null when not given.

sourceSha.description: Source commit (--source-sha); null when not given.

toolchain.description: Toolchain identity; patches are only valid between builds with an identical toolchain.

metro.description: Metro version used by the splitter, e.g. "0.81.5".

units.description: Unit bytecode bundles keyed by unit name.

ids.description: ids.json (module id -> path) copied from the splitter.

unitsMap.description: The splitter's output units.json (see units.output.schema.json), copied into the build dir.

delta.description: Hermes delta compile record (absent in builds made before delta mode). Base releases and `--delta off` builds have enabled false; files then carry only the js hashes.

enabled.description: True if every file was compiled with `hermesc -base-bytecode=<embedded base .hbc>` (unchanged files are copied from the base).

baseBuild.description: sha256 of the base build's build.json (always the EMBEDDED base build, never a delta build); null when enabled is false.

files.description: Per-file record keyed by the build-relative .hbc path ("host.hbc", "units/cabs.hbc").

baseHbc.description: sha256 of the base .hbc used as -base-bytecode for this file (only when enabled).

js.description: sha256 of the JS file (splitter output) this .hbc was compiled from; equal JS in base and new build means the base .hbc is copied unchanged.

file.description: Path relative to the build dir, e.g. "host.hbc" or "units/cabs.hbc".

zstdSize.description: Size of the file zstd-compressed, in bytes (base for the size-ratio limits).

file.description: Path relative to the build dir.
Path relative to the build dir, e.g. "host.hbc" or "units/cabs.hbc".

zstdSize.description: Size of the file zstd-compressed, in bytes (base for the size-ratio limits).

entryModuleId.description: Module id of the unit entry (from the splitter units.json entryId); must not change between base and patch builds.
